class.name: FmodSound3DSettings
class.brief_description: 3D audio scaling settings for the FMOD system.
class.description:
FmodSound3DSettings controls how FMOD translates 3D distances and velocities to audio characteristics. Apply with [method FmodServer.set_sound_3D_settings].
These settings affect all 3D audio globally. Tune them to match your game's world scale.

method.name: get_distance_factor
method.description: Returns the distance factor — how many engine units equal one meter for FMOD's 3D calculations.

method.name: get_doppler_scale
method.description: Returns the Doppler effect scale multiplier.

method.name: get_rolloff_scale
method.description: Returns the rolloff scale multiplier for distance attenuation.

method.name: set_distance_factor
method.description: Sets the distance factor. Use [code]1.0[/code] if one engine unit equals one meter. Adjust to match your game's scale — e.g. [code]0.01[/code] for a game where 100 units = 1 meter.

method.name: set_doppler_scale
method.description: Sets the Doppler effect scale. [code]0.0[/code] disables Doppler; values above [code]1.0[/code] exaggerate the effect.

method.name: set_rolloff_scale
method.description: Sets the rolloff (distance attenuation) scale multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] uses FMOD Studio's authored curves as-is.

members.member: Number of engine units per meter. Scales all 3D distance calculations. Default is [code]1.0[/code].
Doppler effect multiplier. [code]0.0[/code] = off, [code]1.0[/code] = realistic, higher = exaggerated. Default is [code]1.0[/code].
Distance attenuation scale multiplier. Default is [code]1.0[/code].
